name: Cycle crossover instead of order crossover
lesson: Cycle crossover is clearly slower than order crossover on this instance.
lookFor: Same instance, seed and starting population as “berlin52: the nearest neighbour and the optimum”. At generation 200 the best tour is 77.9 % over the optimum (order crossover: 37.6 %) and at 500 it is 24.5 % over (16.6 %); it never gets under the nearest-neighbour tour. Over seeds 1 to 30 the cycle-crossover run is behind the order-crossover run at generation 200 in all 30 runs, and at generation 500 in 29.
